At runtime counts.sameScope++ increments undefined, creating NaN in both attempts.run.sameScope and attempts.today.sameScope. JSON serialization turns those values into null, and the rendered attempt categories omit the correction.

findings.remediation: Update the owning measurement type, initialization and classification/rendering behavior coherently for sameScope (or deliberately normalize it into the existing fix category), with regression coverage. Preserve the admitted sameScope classification on attempts and queued requests.
